parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualityMetricsAggregatorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.82 indicates structurally near-duplicate test methods (`calculatesAvgShaderFPS` at line 319 and `calculatesWorkloadReduction` at line 427), each test exercises a distinct metric concept — average shader FPS versus workload reduction — and their structural resemblance is typical of parallel assertion patterns within a single XCTestCase subclass. Merging or extracting these test methods risks obscuring test intent and coupling unrelated metric assertions. The restraint rule for test fixtures dominates here.
